S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.status: robustness check, NOT a correction of a confound (see C1_1)
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.label: primary recomputed on the three non-OLMo scorers

primary.population: the same 500 fully held-out arena_hard + wildbench tasks

explicitly_forbidden: S1 may never replace, override or become the primary analysis
no rule may switch the primary from the four-scorer 8-cell macro on the basis of S1 or of any observed data
S1 disagreeing with the primary is reported as a limitation of interpretation, not as grounds for discarding either estimate
S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.reporting_note: per Clarification C1_1: an additive answer-family affinity cancels in the paired contrast because the frozen answer is byte-identical across conditions; a scorer-family-by-condition interaction would not, and its direction is not established. S1 tests whether the primary conclusion depends materially on including the OLMo scorer -- it does not establish that no such interaction exists, nor any direction or magnitude of bias in the four-scorer primary.

R4_prior_use_descriptive.confound_statement: Previous-use status is completely confounded with MT-Bench and cannot receive a causal interpretation. All previously-used tasks are MT-Bench; only a handful of MT-Bench tasks are naive, so any group difference is indistinguishable from a MT-Bench vs other-datasets difference.
R4_prior_use_descriptive.forbidden_claim: no statement of the form 'prior exposure changes the effect' may be made from this comparison
R4_prior_use_descriptive.design_level_answer: the primary analysis, restricted to the 500 never-used tasks
